summary: Confirmed $35 base/+$11 FHU. Added 50A + water + sewer, 76 sites (engine 65), 54 ft max, showers/flush/dump/water, year-round on 21 winter sites, off-peak $31, 14-night max, $6.50 fee. Pin 441 m off; stored lakeview looks unearned.
flags: PIN WRONG: stored 39.1454,-82.5119 is about 425 m WSW of the sites' centroid and about 240 m from the nearest site (067), on the lake side of the park. Corrected: about 39.1468,-82.5073 (centroid of ReserveOhio's per-site coordinates; they follow the visible campground road on imagery). The stored elevation was read at the old pin.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (downward): stored lakeview. On leaf-off Esri imagery the sites run east up a wooded hollow from behind the boat-launch lot. The nearest to the lake (64, 66, 67) plot about 70-90 m from the water with the park road and the launch parking between; the rest are farther up the hollow, several hundred metres for the far loop (028 about 500 m). ODNR calls it a 'deeply shaded campground' and claims no lake view; no engine tag does either. 'not waterfront' looks like the right value.
PHONE BLANK: ODNR's campground page lists (740) 384-3345; the park office is (740) 384-4474 (8am-4:30pm daily). Reservations (866) 644-6727.

ODNR's text says 'full service, electric and non-electric sites' but lists no non-electric count, and ReserveOhio has none (inclusion_evidence's '10 non-electric' is not on either). The electric base is therefore the true base.
